primary_source.title: RRS Charles Darwin Cruise 169 report
facts: ABE was used during Leg 2 for plume mapping, detailed seafloor mapping, and hydrothermal field investigation.
ABE151 ran SM2000 bathymetry on 30 m spaced lines at ~50 m altitude.
CD169 science log places the first ABE deployment near 4deg48.41S, 12deg21.17W.
Published CD169 synthesis distinguishes a tectonically controlled hydrothermal region near 4deg02S from the separate ABE/volcanic hydrothermal region near 4deg48S.

reason: The documented ABE/SM2000 focus survey is ~88 km from CAND003 and belongs to the separate ~4deg48S volcanic hydrothermal area, not the ~4deg02S NTD candidate region.
anti_loop_rule: Do not search for or substitute ABE150-155 SM2000 bathymetry as if it covered CAND003 unless a primary source later demonstrates a separate ABE acquisition at the frozen candidate coordinate.
